blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – Micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs) are expected to be the most affected by the implementation of the P42 wage increase for workers in Central Visayas starting Oct. 14. Macario Carl Cabusas II, president of the Talisay City Chamber of Commerce, Trade and Industry, said the wage hike would mean additional costs for small businesses. With the wage increase, the minimum wage for private-sector workers will rise to P582 in Class A areas and P542 in Class B areas. READ: ₱582 or ₱542?
